title: Chuckles on vibes, Green as dancing conductor
summary: Chuckles played vibraphone while Green acted as a comic dancing bandleader, conducting the orchestra and tapping 32 bars; critics called him brilliant.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: And now Chuckles was playing the --
And you were just doing a dance -- were you singing?
Well, I was like a dancing orchestrater, you see, a band leader, like the conductor -- the maestro -- as you would say, you see.
Well, the whole orchestration, you know, the arrangement, you see. And it was like, how you say -- it was some of the quality of the routine, you know. It was part of the routine.
I see. It was sort of a comical kind of thing? Chuck and Chuckles would come out and do their thing -- the band would be playing, you'd pretend like you were conducting it?
Yes, that's it. Like Jerry Lewis does some time -- he tries to go into the magicals of the -- imagination -- imaginaries.
Would you tap dance when you conducted?
Well, partly I did -- about 32 bars, you see, because that was -- that had become popular, you see. That means you had the substance of an artistic performer, you know,
or sensational, so they gave you titles -- the critics, you know, whatever they say about you -- the type of your style, your stylizing, or whatever you --
What did they say about you?
Oh, my goodness. They said that I was brilliant, you see. They said that I was brillaint that I was going to go far, you see, eventually. On the way to stardom -- that's what they said.
